title: Ordinary affine exchange in tensor coordinates
statement: Let R,A,B,D be commutative rings, A and B R-algebras. Assume sheaf derived categories for every scheme [def-pc-derived-category]. Let M be an unbounded A-module complex, phi:A→D and psi:B→D ring maps inducing a commutative spectrum square with f:Spec A→Spec R, g:Spec B→Spec R, p:Spec D→Spec A and fprime:Spec D→Spec B. Let k:B tensor_R res_R M→res_psi(D tensor_phi M) be a B-complex map taking b tensor q to psi(b) tensor q in each degree. Let H be the homotopy class of tilde M and s the ordinary source iso [lem-pc-affine-tilde-tensor-source-comparison]. Assume the fixed p-pullback counit c_H is invertible and let t be the prescribed identity affine tilde representative [def-pc-affine-base-change-tilde-representative-iso]. Write q for Q(tilde_B k), followed by the canonical affine pushforward complex comparison [lem-pc-affine-tilde-pushforward-cohomology-normalization] and the fprime right-derived unit. Then Q(s.hom), followed by Qh of ordinary homotopy exchange [lem-pc-derived-base-change-unit-compatibility] and the fprime right-derived unit on p-pullback H, equals q followed by Rfprime_*(t.hom) and Rfprime_*(c_H). This is an ordinary coefficient and exchange calculation followed by localization; it has no derived tensor model, derived source-comparison isomorphism, K-flatness or cartesian-square hypothesis.

proof.text: Apply the derived transport equality without the invertible-counit assumption. Combine the two final direct-image maps by functoriality, cancel the representative against its supplied invertible counit, and unfold the coefficient target map.

theorem affineTildeTensorOrdinaryExchange
    (R A B D : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (φ : A →+* D) (ψ : B →+* D)
    (hw : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))
    (k : (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R B)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj M)) ⟶
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ψ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M))
    (hk : ∀ (i : ℤ) (b : B) (q : M.X i),
      k.f i (b ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R B] q) = ψ b ⊗ₜ[A,φ] q)
    (hc : IsIso ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).app
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((affineTildeFunctor A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)))) :
    let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
    let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))
    let p := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
    let f' := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ)
    let H := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
      (((affineTildeFunctor A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)
    let t := affineBaseChangeTildeRepresentativeIso A D φ
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((affineTildeFunctor A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)) M (Iso.refl _) hc
    DerivedCategory.Q.map (affineTildeTensorOrdinarySourceIso R A B M).hom ≫
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((moduleHomotopyBaseChange f f' g p hw).app H) ≫
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f'.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj H) =
      affineTildeTensorOrdinaryTargetMap R A B D M φ ψ k ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map t.hom ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit p).app H)
